mapper.insert: INSERT INTO donation_price ( donation_id, user_id, give_price, merchant_uid, status, currency, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{donationId}, #{userId}, #{givePrice}, #{merchantUid}, #{status}, #{currency}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT donation_price_id AS donationPriceId, donation_id AS donationId, user_id AS userId, give_price AS givePrice, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS UpdatedAt, imp_uid AS impUid, merchant_uid AS merchantUid, pg_provider AS pgProvider, pg_tid AS pgTid, pay_method AS payMethod, currency AS currency, status AS status, receipt_url AS receiptUrl, paid_at AS paidAt, deposit_name AS depositName, account_number AS accountNumber, bank_name AS bankName FROM donation_price WHERE merchant_uid = #{merchantUid} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE donation_price SET status = 'PAID', imp_uid = #{impUid}, pg_provider = #{pgProvider}, pg_tid = #{pgTid}, pay_method = #{payMethod}, receipt_url = #{receiptUrl}, paid_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE merchant_uid = #{merchantUid} AND status IN ('READY','FAILED')
